parameter.name: bindAddress
parameter.label: Bind Address
parameter.description: Local IP address the SHIP WebSocket server binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to bind all interfaces.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port

parameter.name: wssPath
parameter.label: WebSocket Path
parameter.description: HTTP path the SHIP WebSocket endpoint is served under.

parameter.name: serviceDomain
parameter.label: mDNS Domain
parameter.description: mDNS domain used for SHIP service advertisement/discovery.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: Unique SPINE device identifier for this node. Change the default to something unique to your installation before pairing with a real EEBus partner.

parameter.name: friendlyName
parameter.label: Friendly Name
parameter.description: Human-readable name advertised to pairing partners.

parameter.name: deviceType
parameter.label: SPINE Device Type
parameter.description: SPINE device type reported to pairing partners.

parameter.name: entityType
parameter.label: SPINE Entity Type
parameter.description: SPINE entity type hosting the LPC/LPP use cases. Limited to the entity types the jEEBus LPC/LPP implementation actually allows (verified live against a real EEBus partner) - CEM is the correct default for a generic controllable system.

parameter.name: connectPolicy
parameter.label: Connect Policy
parameter.description: Which remote SHIP nodes are allowed to connect. TRUSTED only accepts nodes whose SKI is listed below; ALL accepts any node (not recommended); NONE rejects new pairings.

parameter.name: trustedSkis
parameter.label: Trusted SKIs
parameter.description: Comma-separated list of remote SHIP Subject Key Identifiers (SKIs) to pre-trust, e.g. the SKI printed on your CLS gateway. Only used when Connect Policy is "Trusted SKIs only".

parameter.name: autoAcceptPairing
parameter.label: Auto-Accept Pairing Requests
parameter.description: Accept any pairing request without a pre-trusted SKI. Only intended for lab testing against a simulator - never enable this against a production installation.
